description: Runs of spaces are kept in every writer; which spaces a TeX writer writes explicitly.
format: `text` is the whole text of a paragraph; `expected` lists its runs of U+0020 with their UTF-16 `start`, `length`, `position` (leading, between or trailing) and how many spaces are `explicit` for TeX.

cases.description: Single spaces between words need nothing explicit.
A run of three spaces is kept: a TeX writer writes the second and third explicitly.
Leading and trailing spaces are kept, every one explicit.
A paragraph of spaces only is one leading run.
A no-break space is an ordinary character, so it splits a run.
An empty paragraph has no spaces.
